m: 1. प्रती in comp. for प्रति (cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 122, Vārtt. 3, Pat.)

2. प्रती (प्रति-√ इ) P. प्रत्य्-एति, to go towards or against, go to meet (as friend or foe), RV. &c. &c.; to come back, return, ib.; to resort or apply to, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; to fall to a person's (dat.) lot or share, AitBr.; to receive, accept, MBh.; (also Pass.) to admit, recognize, be certain of, be convinced that (2 acc.), GṛŚrS.; Nir.; R. &c.; to trust, believe (with gen.), Kathās. : Pass. प्रतीयते, to be admitted or recognized, follow, result, Kāv.; Śaṃk.; Hit. (p. ˚यमान, known, understood, implicit, Pāṇ.; Sāh.) : Caus. प्रत्य्-आययति (Pass. प्रत्य्-आय्यते), to lead towards i.e. cause to recognize or acknowledge, convince (any one of the truth of anything), Kālid.; to make clear, prove, Śaṃk.; Sāh. : Desid. प्रतीषिषति, to wish or try to understand, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 47, Sch.
a: प्रती — (प्रति-इ) {c2c} P. 1 To go back to, return; प्रतीयाय गुरोः सकाशं R. 5. 35; Bk. 3. 19. --2 To go to, approach, turn to. --3 To fall to the lot of. --4 To reach, attain. --5 To believe, trust, be certain or sure of, rely on; कः प्रत्येति सैवेयमिति U. 4; 1. 44. --6 To learn, understand, know, प्रतीयते धातुरिवे हितं फलैः Ki. 1. 20; Śi. 1. 69. --7 To be well-known or celebrated; सोयं वटः श्याम इति प्रतीतः R. 13. 53. --8 To be pleased or satisfied; प्रति प्रतीतः प्रसवोन्मुखीं प्रियां (ददर्श) R. 3. 12; 16. 23. --Pass. 1 To be recognized or perceived. --2 To be proved, turn out to be true. --3 To follow from anything (as a necessary result). --Caus. (प्रत्याययति) 1 To cause to believe; convince, inspire confidence; एष विवाद एव प्रत्याय यति Ś. 7; 5. 31; ताः स्वचारित्र्यमुद्दिश्य प्नत्याययतु मैथिली R. 15. 73. --2 To cause to perceive, bring to mind. --3 To prove, demonstrate, show.

the following from anything (as a necessary result), being clear or intelligible by itself, Vedāntas.
clear apprehension or insight into anything, complete understanding or ascertainment, conviction, Śak.; Śaṃk.; Kathās. &c.
confidence, faith, belief, Daś.
trust, credit, Inscr.
fame, notoriety, W.
respect, ib.
delight, ib.
a: प्रतीतिः — f. 1 Conviction, settled belief; Ś. 7. 31. --2 Belief. --3 Knowledge, ascertainment, clear or distinct perception or apprehension; अपि तु वाच्यवैचित्र्यप्रतिभासादेव चारुताप्रतीतिः K. P. 10. --4 Fame, renown. --5 Respect. --6 Delight. --7 Going towards, approaching.

m: प्रतीति—मत् mfn. known, understood, Harav.

v: pu॰ “UrdDvaM SAkvaramazwAkzaramaByAsavat tasya hyakzarAn padAdIn pratItodA ityAcakzate” ityukte'rTe ।

प्रती-त्त See अ-प्रतीत्त.
a: प्रतीत्त — a. Given back, restored.

m: प्रतीत्य n. confirmation, experiment, RV. vii, 68, 6
comfort, consolation, ib. iv, 5, 14 (others mfn. to be acknowledged or recognized)
प्रतीत्य—समुत्पाद m. (Buddh.) the chain of causation, Lalit. (twelvefold; cf. Dharmas. 42).
प्रती—वाह m. (cf. प्रति-व्˚) fee, reward, GopBr.; Kauś.

s: pratIvApaH

puM, (pratyupyate prakzipyate aTavA nizicyate'sminniti । prati + vapa nizekAdO + GaY .) galitasya svarRAderdravyAntareRAvacUrRanam । iti svAmI ॥ nyasanam । niHkzepaRamiti yAvat । iti suBUtiH ॥ upadravaH । iti mukuwaH ॥ “AvApastu pratIvApo mArIrItirupadravaH ॥” iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ ityAtaYcanaSabdawIkAyAM BarataH ॥ pAnIyOzaDaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “uzakAdi pratIvApaM pibet saMSamanAya vE ॥” iti vidraDicikitsAyAM cakrapARidattaH ॥ (yaTA ca suSrute sUtrasTAne । 43 aDyAye । “madanaPalamajjakvATaM vA pippalyAdi pratIvApaM taccUrRaM vA nimbarUpikA kazAyayoranyatareRa santarpaRaM kaPajavyADiharam ॥”)
v: pu॰ prati + vapa--GaY dIrGaH । 1 galitasvarRAderavacUrRane amaraH । 2 peyozaDiBede OzaDaviSezasaMyogaBede ca “tatra vIratarvAdisidDaM jalamUzakAdi pratIvApaM pAyayet” suSrutaH ।
m: प्रती—वाप m. = प्रति-व्˚, Suśr.
a disease, pestilence, L.
a: प्रतीवापः — 1 Adding to, inserting (as an ingredient). --2 Calcining or fluxing metals. --3 An epidemic disease, a plague.

m: प्रती—वी mfn. (cf. प्रति-√ वी) receiving gladly, accepting, RV.
प्रती—वी m. or f. acceptance, ib.
प्रती—वर्त mfn. returning into itself (= परिसर), AV.
(accord. to others, ‘attacking, assailing’).

m: प्रतीष् (प्रति-√ इष्) P. प्रतीच्छति (ind.p. प्रतीष्य), to strive after, seek, RV. x, 129, 4; to receive, accept from, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to regard, mind, attend to, obey, ib.
a: प्रतीष् — {c6c} P. 1 To receive, accept; देवस्य शासनं प्रतीष्य Ś. 6. --2 To welcome, greet, receive, honour; एष माधवीमंडपः स्वागतेनैव नौ प्रतीच्छति Ś. 6. --3 To obey (as an order). --4 To wait for, expect; एष खलु त्वां प्रतीच्छति V. 2.

m: प्रतीषित mfn. (√ ईष्) stretched out towards, Kāṭh.

a: प्रतीष्ट — p. p. Accepted, received &c.
